_readme: These are public list-price estimates (USD per 1,000 tokens). They are NOT pulled from any live billing API and have NOT been verified against actual provider invoices — verify against real provider billing before using any cost figure derived from this file in a hospital-facing or funding claim. Rates are per-model, not per-account, so a discount or negotiated rate on your own OpenRouter/Groq account won't be reflected here. '_default' is used for any model not explicitly listed below.
